moderationOutcome.title: A moderation decision about your content
moderationOutcome.body: Outcome: {action}. Reason: {reason}. You can appeal once within 15 days from Profile → My moderation outcomes. Grievances: {contact}

appealDelayed.title: Your appeal is taking longer than planned
appealDelayed.body: It has been escalated and you'll hear back soon. Grievances: {contact}

verificationReminder.title: Reconfirm verification: {name}
verificationReminder.body: Your verification expires in a month. Submit a current document to keep your verified label.

digest.title: {count} new opportunities for you
digest.body: Open Vyapar to see what's new since your last digest.

reviewInvite.title: How did it go? Leave a review
reviewInvite.body: You can recommend them within 30 days. Reviews on Vyapar come only from real interactions.

partnershipReceived.title: New partnership request from {name}
partnershipReceived.body: Open it to see what they need and offer, then accept or decline.

partnershipUpdated.title: Partnership request {state}
partnershipUpdated.body: Open the request to see what happens next.

reviewDisputeOutcome.title: A disputed review has been decided

reviewAutoHidden.title: Your review was hidden
reviewAutoHidden.body: The conversation it was about was removed by moderation, so your review is hidden too. Grievances: {contact}

promotionActive.title: Your boost is live
promotionActive.body: Sponsored until {date}. Eligibility, verification and organic ranking are unchanged.

paymentFailed.title: Payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.body: Your boost order is saved for 24 hours. Retry from the boost page.

promotionPaused.title: Boost paused and credited
promotionPaused.body: The boosted item is no longer active, so the boost stopped. Unused time credited: {amount}.

promotionRejected.title: Boost rejected
promotionRejected.body: Reason: {reason}. A full refund has been requested. Grievances: grievance@forkhatri.example

entitlementActive.title: Business Workspace is active
entitlementActive.body: Your plan runs to {date}. Team roles and campaigns are unlocked. Verification, reputation and ranking are never part of a plan.

entitlementRenewalReminder.title: Your plan renews on {date}
entitlementRenewalReminder.body: Nothing is charged automatically — we will ask you to complete the payment. Cancel any time before then from your workspace.

entitlementRenewalDue.title: Renewal payment due
entitlementRenewalDue.body: Complete the renewal payment by {date} to keep team roles and campaigns. Your data stays either way.

entitlementPaused.title: Business Workspace paused
entitlementPaused.body: Reason: {reason}. Team roles and campaigns are locked; all your data is kept and returns the moment the plan is active again.

entitlementEnded.title: Business Workspace ended
entitlementEnded.body: Your plan ran to {date} and was not renewed, as you asked. All your data is kept.

workspaceInvite.title: You have been invited to {business}
workspaceInvite.body: Role: {role}. Open your profile to accept or decline. The invite expires in 30 days.

workspaceRoleRevoked.title: Your role at {business} was removed
workspaceRoleRevoked.body: You no longer act for this business on Vyapar. Your own ForKhatri account is unaffected.

campaignActive.title: Your campaign is live
campaignActive.body: Every item runs as a labelled Sponsored boost until {date}. Organic ranking is unchanged.

campaignCompleted.title: Campaign finished
campaignCompleted.body: {name} has ended. Its report stays available.
